<AppBlock
  title="Mini App · 交互式画板"
  icon="app-chatgpt"
  app_block_id="paint-demo-01"
  variant="inline"
>
<div id="paintapp" style="font-family:system-ui;padding:14px;color:var(--viz-text)">
<style>
#paintapp .tools {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

#paintapp button {
  border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
  background: var(--viz-card);
  color: var(--viz-text);
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#paintapp button.active {
  background: var(--viz-accent-bg);
  border-color: var(--viz-accent);
}

#paintapp canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 260px;
  touch-action: none;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  cursor: crosshair;
}

#paintapp .swatch {
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
</style>

<div class="tools">
  <button
    class="swatch active"
    data-color="#202020"
    style="background:#202020"
  ></button>

  <button
    class="swatch"
    data-color="#3b82f6"
    style="background:#3b82f6"
  ></button>

  <button
    class="swatch"
    data-color="#ef4444"
    style="background:#ef4444"
  ></button>

  <button
    class="swatch"
    data-color="#16a34a"
    style="background:#16a34a"
  ></button>

  <label style="font-size:12px">
    笔刷
    <input
      type="range"
      min="2"
      max="25"
      value="5"
      id="brush"
    >
  </label>

  <button id="clear">清空</button>
</div>

<canvas id="paintCanvas"></canvas>

<div style="font-size:12px;opacity:.65;margin-top:8px">
  鼠标或触屏拖动即可绘画
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const root = document.getElementById('paintapp');
  const canvas = root.querySelector('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let color = '#202020';
  let size = 5;
  let drawing = false;

  function resize() {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    const old = document.createElement('canvas');
    old.width = canvas.width;
    old.height = canvas.height;

    old.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);

    canvas.width = rect.width * devicePixelRatio;
    canvas.height = rect.height * devicePixelRatio;

    ctx.setTransform(
      devicePixelRatio, 0,
      0, devicePixelRatio,
      0, 0
    );

    ctx.drawImage(old, 0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
  }

  resize();

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b => {
    b.onclick = () => {
      color = b.dataset.color;

      root.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(
        x => x.classList.remove('active')
      );

      b.classList.add('active');
    };
  });

  root.querySelector('#brush').oninput = e => {
    size = Number(e.target.value);
  };

  root.querySelector('#clear').onclick = () => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  };

  function point(e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    return [
      e.clientX - r.left,
      e.clientY - r.top
    ];
  }

  canvas.onpointerdown = e => {
    drawing = true;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);

    const [x, y] = point(e);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
  };

  canvas.onpointermove = e => {
    if (!drawing) return;

    const [x, y] = point(e);

    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = size;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  canvas.onpointerup = canvas.onpointercancel = () => {
    drawing = false;
  };
})();
</script>
</div>
</AppBlock>
